ignoreCommand: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && echo "ignore-step: prev=${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA:-none} head=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" && git fetch --quiet --deepen=50 2>/dev/null; git cat-file -e "${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || { echo "ignore-step: base unreachable, building"; exit 1; }; git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD -- . ':(exclude)docs' ':(exclude)*.md' && echo "ignore-step: docs only, skipping" || { echo "ignore-step: code changed, building"; exit 1; }
